content:
hello everyone sorry me and <@1335660981019480075> couldnt join the standup yesterday as we were both travelling so sharing our quick updates here

as for me, after completing the 10 transaction variants of eip6404 last week, i moved on to the source adapters connecting reth execution outputs to our retained payload having receipts, transactions, withdrawals, requests and BAL. also resolved the Amsterdam gas accounting difference. after that i looked into where the builder drops the full execution output and how to retain it for the live integration.

arsh completed the multiproofs, bounded receipt filters, component queries and receipt proof helpers, along with the native body types and worked on the existing RPC paths to connect these helpers with the actual node.

for week19, i'll focus on the live builder and Engine integration, receiver validation and the compatible CL setup. arsh will work on the query and receipt RPC integration and consistent block identity across RPC and BLOCKHASH.
also we have started working on our presentation for devcon side by side.

thankyou!!
